## What is happening
The tool picked Crawler Nappies at the NSW DC. 12 of 17 NSW stores are out of stock, the region has 0.6 weeks of cover and it loses AUD 467 of sales a week. The cause is the supplier. Since 1 May, Rascal & Co has filled only 38% of NSW orders, against 88.1% before. Two orders came in about 38% full (PO-000819 and PO-001057), and no orders are open. QLD and VIC were filled 100% over the same period, so the problem is limited to NSW. The shortage blocks the campaign **Crawler Nappies Surge – Loyalty Push**, which has 3,374 treated members at the stores that are out.

## The options
| | First stock | Stockout days | Lost sales | Transfer cost | PO stock value | Cover after | VIC cover after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Do nothing | 14 Jul | 33 | AUD 2,201 | – | – | – | – |
| A: Move 125 from VIC | 14 Jun | 3 | AUD 200 | AUD 144 | – | 6.0 wks | 5.7 wks |
| B: Emergency order of 240 | 26 Jun | 15 | AUD 1,001 | – | AUD 3,925 | 4.6 wks | – |
| **C: Both** | **14 Jun** | **3** | **AUD 200** | **AUD 144** | **AUD 3,925** | **10.0 wks** | **5.7 wks** |



- **A, transfer only:** this meets the 6-week target, but stock runs out around **26 July**. The next regular order (due 14 July) can't be relied on at a 38% fill rate, so NSW is exposed again from then.
- **B, emergency order only:** at 38% fill, only about **91 of the 240 units** would arrive. Cover would reach 4.6 weeks, short of the 6-week target, and the stores stay out of stock for 15 days.

## Recommendation
**Option C.** It's the only option that meets the 6-week target and lasts until supply NSW can count on. It also gets stock in earliest (14 June), and VIC keeps 5.7 weeks of its own cover. Confirm the order quantity with Rascal & Co before counting on the emergency order.

## What approval does
The transfer lands within 7 days, so the 12 NSW stores move from SHORT to LOW. That removes the campaign's stock block for the 3,374 treated members at those stores. Option B alone would not: those stores stay SHORT until the order arrives.

Plan **RCV-11170329197** is a draft for a supply planner to approve on the Stockout recovery page.
